Players Committee card image of [[Dr. Chelli Lona Aphra]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Deploys free to an unoccupied site. Your droids are deploy -1 here. When deployed, may search your Lost Pile and move one card there to the top of that pile (if that card is a droid, may retrieve it into hand).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/drchellilonaaphra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
